purpose_context: Phase 3 preserves Spec Kitty's larger mission methodology while replacing hand-maintained Markdown tasks with Beads-backed structured work. A human or agent must be able to specify, plan, decompose, finalize an immutable WorkRevision, detect later tracker drift, reconcile it explicitly, and advance through a typed next protocol without allowing tracker status to acquire mission or execution authority.
purpose_tldr: Run governed software-development missions from intent to finalized tracker work without a canonical Markdown task ledger.
